notes.title: First update to our game.
notes.content:
Dear player, with this small update. We optimized level loading flow , improved the loading performance of the level, 
and added some battle winning effects to the boss level, and reduced the frequency of flying monsters shooting. 
Thank you for your support. We will continue to update and improve our game.

tags.feature: added some battle winning effects to the boss level

tags.balance_change: reduced the frequency of flying monsters shooting
